page: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a KVM-based Cloud GPU server powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor with 30 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture. Operating at a base frequency of 2.75 GHz, the CPU features 16 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Vector Neural Network Instructions. The system is equipped with 180 GB of system memory, providing 6 GB of RAM per core, alongside a 400 GB NVMe SSD for local storage and a 16 Gbps baseline network interface.

The server integrates two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. In benchmark testing, this hardware configuration achieves top-tier performance in the top 10% for large language model inference, demonstrating high throughput in both prompt processing and text generation across 135M, 7B, and 70B parameter models. Additionally, the server exhibits strong multi-core CPU performance and database operations, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and Passmark CPU tests, while maintaining average performance in uncached memory bandwidth and single-core Geekbench tasks.

From a resource density perspective, the l40s-180 offers a balanced hardware profile that pairs dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores with dual enterprise-grade GPUs, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient platform for workloads that require parallel processing without the overhead of larger multi-GPU clusters. This server is suited for machine learning workloads, including LLM inference, deep learning training, and high-throughput data processing. It also supports database operations, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and cryptographic processing.
